name: Rock
description: A broad genre of popular music that emerged in the 1950s, characterized by electric guitars, drums, and strong rhythms.

name: Hard Rock
description: A louder, more aggressive style of rock featuring heavy guitar riffs and powerful vocals.

name: Punk Rock
description: A raw, fast-paced rock genre with simple chords and rebellious themes.

name: Post-Punk
description: An experimental evolution of punk with darker atmospheres, unconventional structures, and influences from electronic music.

name: Garage Rock
description: A raw, energetic style of rock that emerged in the 1960s with lo-fi production and simple riffs.

name: Alternative Rock
description: A broad rock category that diverges from mainstream trends, often experimental and independent.

name: Grunge
description: A subgenre of alternative rock characterized by distorted guitars, angst-filled lyrics, and Seattle roots.

name: Indie Rock
description: Rock made outside major label influence, often experimental, lo-fi, or unconventional.

name: Progressive Rock
description: Rock music that incorporates experimental structures, complex instrumentals, and conceptual themes.

name: Psychedelic Rock
description: Rock inspired by psychedelic culture, using experimental sounds, effects, and surreal lyrics.

name: Metal
description: A genre evolving from rock, known for distorted guitars, heavy drumming, and powerful vocals.

name: Heavy Metal
description: The foundational style of metal with loud guitars, emphatic rhythms, and soaring vocals.

name: Thrash Metal
description: Fast, aggressive metal characterized by palm-muted guitar riffs and rapid drumming.

name: Death Metal
description: An extreme subgenre of metal with growled vocals, heavily distorted guitars, and complex structures.

name: Melodic Death Metal
description: A blend of death metal and melody, featuring harmonized guitars and growled vocals.

name: Black Metal
description: A raw, atmospheric form of metal characterized by shrieked vocals and dark themes.

name: Doom Metal
description: A slow, heavy form of metal with dark, melancholic themes.

name: Folk Metal
description: A fusion of heavy metal with folk instruments and themes from traditional music.

name: Symphonic Metal
description: A metal subgenre combining heavy guitar with orchestral and operatic elements.

name: Pop
description: Popular music focused on catchy melodies, simple structures, and mass appeal.

name: Dance Pop
description: Pop music with strong beats designed for dancing, influenced by electronic music.

name: Synthpop
description: A pop style emphasizing synthesizers and electronic sounds, popular in the 1980s.

name: K-Pop
description: South Korean pop music blending pop, hip hop, and electronic influences with choreographed performances.

name: Hip Hop
description: A cultural movement and music genre featuring rhythmic speech (rapping) over beats.

name: Trap
description: A subgenre of hip hop with 808 bass, hi-hats, and themes of street life.

name: Boom Bap
description: A hip hop style with hard-hitting drum loops and lyrical emphasis, popular in the 1990s.

name: Gangsta Rap
description: Hip hop focusing on gritty narratives of street life and violence.

name: Jazz
description: A music genre originating in African-American communities, characterized by swing, improvisation, and complex harmonies.

name: Bebop
description: A fast, complex form of jazz emphasizing improvisation and virtuosic solos.

name: Swing
description: A jazz style from the 1930s with strong rhythm and big band arrangements.

name: Cool Jazz
description: A smoother, more relaxed form of jazz developed in the 1950s.

name: Free Jazz
description: Avant-garde jazz characterized by free improvisation and rejection of standard structures.

name: Jazz Fusion
description: A genre combining jazz improvisation with rock, funk, and electronic elements.

name: Blues
description: A genre rooted in African-American history, using expressive lyrics and the 12-bar chord progression.

name: Delta Blues
description: One of the earliest blues styles, originating in the Mississippi Delta with raw vocals and slide guitar.

name: Chicago Blues
description: An electrified blues style that developed in Chicago with amplified instruments.

name: Soul
description: A genre combining gospel, R&B, and jazz, emphasizing deep vocals and emotional expression.

name: Neo-Soul
description: A modern evolution of soul blending R&B, funk, and hip hop elements.

name: Funk
description: A rhythmic genre emphasizing groove, basslines, and syncopated rhythms.

name: Electronic
description: Music produced mainly with electronic instruments, synthesizers, and digital production.

name: House
description: A form of electronic dance music with repetitive 4/4 beats, steady basslines, and club orientation.

name: Deep House
description: A smoother, atmospheric style of house music with jazz and soul influences.

name: Tech House
description: A fusion of house and techno with rhythmic, minimal beats.

name: Techno
description: A subgenre of electronic dance music focusing on repetitive rhythms and synthetic sounds.

name: Trance
description: Electronic dance music with uplifting melodies, long builds, and breakdowns.

name: Drum and Bass
description: Fast-paced electronic music featuring breakbeats, heavy bass, and jungle influences.

name: Dubstep
description: A bass-heavy style of electronic music with syncopated rhythms and wobble bass.

name: Ambient
description: Electronic music focusing on atmosphere, textures, and soundscapes rather than rhythm.

name: Country
description: A genre rooted in American folk traditions, often featuring guitars, storytelling, and rural themes.

name: Bluegrass
description: A country style with banjos, fiddles, and fast-paced acoustic instrumentation.

name: Honky Tonk
description: A lively style of country music with piano, steel guitars, and barroom themes.

name: Outlaw Country
description: A rebellious style of country music rejecting Nashville's polished production.

name: Folk
description: Traditional and modern music based on storytelling, acoustic instruments, and cultural roots.

name: Indie Folk
description: A contemporary form of folk with indie rock and pop influences.

name: Classical
description: Art music rooted in Western traditions, spanning centuries from Baroque to contemporary orchestral works.

name: Baroque
description: A style of classical music from the 17th–18th centuries, featuring ornate melodies and counterpoint.

name: Romantic
description: A 19th-century classical style emphasizing emotion, drama, and expressive orchestration.

name: Modern Classical
description: 20th and 21st century classical music with experimental and contemporary approaches.

name: Reggae
description: A Jamaican genre with offbeat rhythms, laid-back grooves, and themes of social consciousness.

name: Ska
description: A precursor to reggae, combining Caribbean rhythms with jazz and R&B influences.

name: Dub
description: A subgenre of reggae emphasizing remixing, echo effects, and heavy bass.

name: Dancehall
description: A Jamaican genre derived from reggae with faster rhythms and DJ-style vocals.

name: Latin
description: A diverse category of music from Latin America, featuring rhythmic diversity and cultural fusion.

name: Salsa
description: A lively dance music style from the Caribbean, combining Afro-Cuban rhythms with jazz.

name: Bossa Nova
description: A Brazilian style blending samba rhythms with smooth jazz harmonies.

name: Flamenco
description: A Spanish genre combining guitar, singing, and dance with passionate expression.
